scenario_1_silent_failure.symptom: HTTP 500 increments http_requests_total metric, but no error log appears
scenario_1_silent_failure.root_cause: Swallowed catch block returning res.status(500) directly without invoking logger.error() or forwarding via next(err) to globalErrorHandler.
scenario_1_silent_failure.remediation: Always delegate exceptions to centralized globalErrorHandler via next(err) and emit structured error logs with stack trace and request_id.

scenario_2_cardinality_bomb.symptom: GET /metrics grows linearly in payload size and memory consumption with each unique user or request
scenario_2_cardinality_bomb.root_cause: High-cardinality unbounded values (user_id, request_id, raw dynamic paths) attached as Prometheus metric labels, creating millions of time series.
scenario_2_cardinality_bomb.remediation: Restrict Prometheus labels to strictly bounded low-cardinality dimensions (method, normalized route template /r/:code, status) and keep user_id/request_id exclusively in structured logs.

scenario_3_missing_request_id.symptom: Every log line emits request_id: null or undefined, breaking cross-log correlation
scenario_3_missing_request_id.root_cause: Middleware ordering bug (loggingMiddleware registered before requestIdMiddleware) or broken header extraction without UUID fallback.
scenario_3_missing_request_id.remediation: Mount requestIdMiddleware as the very first Express middleware, normalize x-request-id header lookup, generate a crypto.randomUUID() fallback, and reflect X-Request-Id in the response header.
